evidence.supports: Oregon LLCs file Articles of Organization and annual reports; members generally have limited liability for LLC debts
evidence.limitations: Does not determine whether an LLC is right for Tucker or eliminate personal exposure

evidence.topic: Oregon LLC fees and public records
evidence.supports: Oregon LLC filing information is generally public and the Articles processing fee is currently $100
evidence.limitations: Fees and filing practices can change

evidence.supports: A one-owner LLC is generally disregarded for federal income tax unless another classification is elected; EIN requirements depend on circumstances
Selling investment interests implicates securities rules; exemptions and regulated crowdfunding have specific requirements
evidence.limitations: Counsel is required for an actual offering
